title: Curved storage seat
summary: A curved bench seat with storage under lift-up lids, made to sit in a kitchen bay.
intro: A curved bench for a kitchen bay, next to a round table. It was drawn by hand first, then built in MDF: curved frames, storage boxes underneath and lift-up lids on top, with panelled fronts.
